name: El Camí IT1TR5 El Camí Capçaler: de Salzes a Balaguer
description_md:
El Camí IT1TR5 El Camí Capçaler: de Salzes a Balaguer is an 83.5 km waymarked hiking route in AD. Classified as hard derived from distance and ascent, the route includes 4549 m of ascent, 4596 m of descent, and takes about 35 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The trail is part of the national waymarked hiking network and is signposted as CC-C. Along the way, the route passes Esglesia Sant Esteve de Andorra la Vella within 300 m and Roc de les Bruixes within 400 m.
